name: omp-jev-router
description: Keeps the primary model fixed while deciding orchestration and review needs with Jev; plugin-owned coordination guidance over OMP's native task worker, with checkpoint reviews and independent verification.

enabled.description: Master switch for routing and mandatory review enforcement. Manual review/finding tools remain available.

jevModel.description: TypeSafe model id; empty uses the SDK default (jev-latest).

orchestrationRoutingEnabled.description: Allow the ORCHESTRATE execution route. Independent risk/review assessment remains active; the primary model never changes.

orchestrationMinConfidence.description: Minimum confidence for orchestration; below the gate keep DEFAULT and the current primary model.

orchestrationMinMargin.description: Minimum top1 - top2 margin for orchestration; below the gate keep DEFAULT.

routingTimeoutMs.description: Hard per-decision budget; expiry falls back instead of retrying.

maxRoutingInputChars.description: Combined character budget for the request, visible conversation and committed plan sent to Jev (excluding JSON framing and fixed classifier instructions).

telemetryEnabled.description: Aggregate local orchestration decisions and observed task-worker usage. No prompt text is stored.

debugLogging.description: Emit one metrics-only line per orchestration decision to the OMP log.

scripts.build: bun run check && bun run lint && bun test
scripts.format: oxfmt src test bin package.json tsconfig.json
